text:
lina: FYI Acme asked for a market-facing bundle that ties a committed marketplace spend to a per-device rebate. They want clear conversion path from metered -> commit and renewal hooks. Thoughts?

tom: key Qs: how do we count committed usage (invoice date vs usage date)? do rebates reduce committed cadence or sit separate?

acme-pm: we prefer usage date. rebates as separate device-level credits paid quarterly is fine. main ask: ability to top-up credits mid-quarter.

kevin-sales: For field simplicity we should show an "Estimated effective discount" on the SKU page. Sales needs a calculator: if customer commits X/year, show net effective price after marketplace credit + HW rebate.

partner-eng: integration note: marketplace credits require SKU attachment metadata. We need a list of affected SKUs + partner SKU IDs. Also need a reconciliation webhook if credits are consumed programmatically.

sophia-legal: Legal flags: (1) cap cumulative rebates per account per year, (2) require evidence of device shipment for rebate eligibility, (3) include an audit clause. Also propose a 30-day settlement window after quarter close.

orbit-marketing: Launch timeline check: creative and PR review need 3w. Recommend soft-launch to limited accounts + partner case study before broad announcement.

lina: Operational constraints: our marketplace charges a transaction fee on credits. We should decide whether partner co-funds gross credit or net (after fees). Prefer partners pay gross so customer sees full discount.

acme-pm: Acme prefers gross co-fund. They also want telemetry access to confirmed conversions to reconcile rebates. Can we provide partner-facing dashboard?

partner-eng: We can expose partner reporting with aggregated, anonymized metrics. For per-customer rebate reconciliation we'll need an NDA Append & scoped access.

kevin-sales: Renewal mechanics: if customer converts to an annual commit after using credits, do credits rollover into the new contract? Sales prefers credits not rolling forward into new contracted commitments to avoid double-counting.

sophia-legal: Agree: credits expire (6 or 12 months). If they convert, we can offset first invoice of new contract but not extend credit validity. Need explicit language.

lina: Pricing ops recommend 6 months expiry to limit liability. We'll allow a one-time roll-forward to an account credit at expiry if legal approves.

tom: Billing flows: two options — (A) apply credit at checkout (instant visibility) or (B) post-bill rebate (reconciliation). Checkout is better UX but requires marketplace SKU wiring. Rebate is operationally simpler.

acme-pm: Acme strongly prefers checkout application to simplify field discussions.

partner-eng: Checkout path: need SKU mapping + entitlement rules + marketplace API changes. Estimate ~4 dev sprints to support fully across regions. Canary in NA first.

kevin-sales: Can we limit starter tier to self-serve and gate growth/enterprise to partner approval? Keep field workload reasonable.

lina: Yes, gate Growth/Enterprise to partner-ops approval. Add manual review step for high-rebate deals.

orbit-marketing: For PR wording avoid publishing exact rebate $ amounts. Publish ranges and exemplar customer stories.

kevin-sales: One more ask: create a quick sales play one-pager with examples (3 ARR scenarios) and FAQ (billing, expiry, downgrade).

sophia-legal: I'll draft the contract appendix with caps, device proof, and audit language. Need final rebate bands by Friday.

acme-pm: We'll send proposed banding and quarterly co-fund caps by EOD tomorrow.

lina: Ops next steps: (1) pricing ops to convert bands to SKU credit values; (2) partner-eng to scope checkout changes and reporting; (3) legal to draft appendix; (4) marketing to prepare launch plan. Next sync Thur 10am PT.

partner-eng: Created a GH issue for checkout work and assigned initial spike to @alex.

kevin-sales: I'll draft the sales play and drop in the channel.

orbit-marketing: Adding tentative launch date: Aug 15 (soft) / Sep 1 (broad) to calendar.

lina: Thanks all. If no blockers we'll finalize numbers Fri and route to exec review over the weekend.
